footer.free: VAIBHAV free. Search, interest, message-ku naangal eppovum kattanam vaanguvadhillai.

common.draftNotice: Draft content — launch-ku munnaadi review pending.

home.title: Nambikkaiyodum mariyaadhaiyodum vaazhkkai thunaiyai kandupidiyungal
home.subtitle: Tamil Nadu Tamil kudumbangalukkaana thirumana sevai. Profile create pannunga, porutthamaana varangalai kandupidiyunga, safe-aa pesunga — muzhusaa free.

pillars.freeBody: Search, interest, message ellaame ovvoru member-kkum free. Paid boost illa, hidden ranking illa.
pillars.safeBody: Unga phone number, sariyaana pirandha thedhi, documents ellaam private-aave irukkum. Unga photos-a yaar paakkalaam-nu neenga dhaan mudivu seiyanum.
pillars.verifiedBody: Ovvoru profile-um publish aagura munnaadi review pannappadum. Enna check pannom-nu badges theliva sollum.
pillars.familyBody: Kalyaanam pannikkapporavanga oppudhal irundhaal mattum dhaan parents profile-a manage panna udhavalaam.

steps.two: Unga profile-um partner preferences-um create pannunga
steps.four: Interest anuppunga; rendu perum ok sonnaa chat pannunga

auth.loginSubtitle: Unga mobile number kudunga. Oru one-time code anuppuvom.
auth.consentTerms: Enakku 18 vayasu illa adhukku mela, <terms>Terms of Use</terms> matrum <privacy>Privacy Notice</privacy>-a ettukkaren.
auth.neverShare: VAIBHAV staff indha code-a eppovum kekka maattaanga. Yaar kittayum share pannaadheenga.

dashboard.nextStepBody: Matches-a sandhikka unga profile-a mudinga. Eppo venumnaalum save panni thirumba varalaam.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageBody: VAIBHAV ungalukku eppadi theriyanum-nu select pannunga. Tanglish-na English ezhutthula ezhudhura Tamil.
settings.sessionsBody: Ungalukku theriyaadha devices-la irundhu logout pannunga.

about.title: VAIBHAV pathi
about.body: VAIBHAV Tamil kudumbangalukkaana free, kalyaana nokkudaiya platform. Mariyaadhaiyaana arimugangal, transparent matching, strong privacy controls — idhula dhaan engal kavanam.

howItWorks.title: Eppadi velai seiyudhu
howItWorks.body: Mobile number-oda register panni, profile-a complete panni, partner preferences set panni, matches kandupidiyunga. Rendu perum interest-a accept pannaa VAIBHAV-kulla safe-aa chat pannalaam.

safety.title: Safety centre
safety.body: Online-la sandhikkura yaarukkum panam anuppaadheenga. Unga OTP-a eppovum share pannaadheenga. Platform-ku veliya pesa pressure kudukkuravanga illa panam kekkuravangala report pannunga. Endha profile-aiyum eppo venumnaalum block, report pannalaam.

faq.title: Adikkadi kekkura kelvigal
faq.body: VAIBHAV free-aa? Aamaa — register, search, interest, message ellaame ovvoru member-kkum free.

contact.title: Engala thodarbu kollunga
contact.body: Support contact details launch-ku munnaadi publish aagum.

eligibility.title: Samooga thagudhi
eligibility.body: VAIBHAV oru kurippitta Tamil samoogathukkaaga launch aagudhu. Approval kidaichadhum thagudhi details publish aagum.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.body: Terms of Use legal counsel-oda finalise aagittu irukku; launch-ku munnaadi publish aagum.

privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.body: Privacy Notice legal counsel-oda finalise aagittu irukku; launch-ku munnaadi publish aagum.

errors.generic: Edho thappu nadandhudichu. Thirumba try pannunga.
errors.network: VAIBHAV-a reach panna mudiyala. Connection-a check panni thirumba try pannunga.
errors.otp_cooldown: Pudhu code kekkuradhukku munnaadi konjam wait pannunga.
errors.rate_limited: Romba attempts. Konja neram kazhichu try pannunga.
errors.otp_expired: Indha code expire aagiduchu. Pudhusa kelunga.
errors.otp_too_many_attempts: Romba thappaana attempts. Pudhu code kelunga.
errors.consent_required: Continue panna Terms of Use matrum Privacy Notice-a accept pannunga.
errors.account_inactive: Indha account available illa. Support-a contact pannunga.
errors.session_expired: Unga session mudinjiduchu. Thirumba login pannunga.
errors.underage: 18 vayasu illa adhukku mela irukkuravangalukku mattum dhaan profile.
errors.contact_details_not_allowed: Text-la irundhu phone number, email, links-a neekkunga.
errors.profile_incomplete: Submit pannura munnaadi thevaiyaana sections-a mudinga.
errors.delegation_scope: Profile-oda indha part-ku ungalukku permission illa.
errors.owner_only: Indha profile-ukkuriyavanga mattum dhaan idha seiya mudiyum.
errors.profile_exists: Indha nabarukku already oru profile irukku.
errors.invalid_image: Theliva JPG, PNG illa WebP photo upload pannunga.
errors.image_too_small: Indha photo romba chinnadhu. Perusaa use pannunga.

review_reason.contact_in_text: Unga text-la irundhu contact details-a neekkunga

profile.subjectNameHint: Avanga connect aagura nabargalukku mattum dhaan theriyum.
profile.subjectPhoneHint: Edhaiyum serkkura munnaadi avanga indha number-la login panni oppudhal kudukkanum. Andha nabaroda oppudhal irundhaa mattum dhaan profile create aagum.
profile.createCtaBody: Sumaar 10 nimisham aagum. Save panni appuram mudikkalaam.
profile.awaitingConsentBody: {name}-ku message anuppirukkom. Avanga login panni oppudhal kuduthadhum neenga udhavalaam.

statusBody.draft: Thevaiyaana sections-a mudichu review-ku submit pannunga.
statusBody.submitted: Engal team unga profile-a review pannudhu. Podhuvaa oru naalukkulla mudinjidum.
statusBody.approved: Unga profile live-la irukku; approved members-ku theriyum.
statusBody.needs_changes: Unga profile-a update panni thirumba submit pannunga.
statusBody.suspended: Indha profile suspend aagiduchu. Support-a contact pannunga.

profile.pausedBody: Unga profile maraikkappattirukku. Pudhusaa yaarum kandupidikka mudiyaadhu.
profile.materialChangeWarning: Peyar, pirandha thedhi, kalyaana nilai, samoogam illa unga text-a maathinaa, live profile oru chinna review-ku pogum.

fields.dobHint: Members unga vayasa mattum dhaan paappaanga, pirandha thedhiya illa.
fields.subCommunityHint: Optional. Launch samoogam confirm aagura varaikkum idhu thaatkaalika peyargal.
fields.incomeHint: Optional. Company matrum varumaanam keezha irukkura visibility setting-a follow pannum.
fields.aboutMeHint: Ungala pathi sila vari. Phone number, email, links serkkaadheenga.

photos.title: Photos
photos.intro: Andha nabaroda 1 mudhal 6 theliva photos serunga. Matra members paakkura munnaadi engal team check pannum.
photos.hint: JPG, PNG illa WebP, 8 MB varaikkum. Location, camera details thaanaa neekkappadum.

preferences.title: Partner preferences
preferences.intro: Neenga enna thedureenga-nu sollunga. Ovvonnaiyum kattaayam, virupam illa flexible-nu mark pannunga — matches indha choices vechu dhaan explain aagum.

delegation.subjectInvite: {inviter} ungalukkaaga oru kalyaana profile start panniyirukkaanga
delegation.subjectInviteBody: Unga oppudhal illaama edhuvum publish aagaadhu. Accept pannaa profile ungaludaiyadhu aagum; unga kudumba nabar edhula udhavalaam-nu neenga dhaan mudivu pannuveenga.
delegation.helpersIntro: Unga profile-la udhava parents illa uravinarai azhaiyunga. Avanga sondha mobile number-la login pannuvaanga; eppo venumnaalum neekkalaam.

previewPage.title: Members-ku indha profile eppadi theriyum
previewPage.banner: Preview: approved members idha paappaanga. Photos approve aanadhum theriyum.
